feature: Indirect integer start code and indirect glyph-name objects inside a simple-font /Differences array
source_location: Primary ISO 32000-2 EC3: §7.3.10 physical p.49 / printed p.34 states direct and indirect object values are semantically equivalent absent a documented exception. Table 112 and its Differences sequence syntax are physical pp.337–338 / printed pp.322–323; the sequence paragraph states each integer begins a sequence, each following name assigns that and successive codes until the next integer. Type 1 mapping text is physical p.339 / printed p.324. Table 112 calls Differences optional and says it should not be used with TrueType fonts; that is a recommendation, not a directness exception or prohibition.
errata: No effective directness exception for Difference array elements was located in Table 112 or the applicable Type 1/TrueType mapping paragraphs. I did not certify all simple-font errata; this review focuses on direct-versus-indirect array member semantics.
test_assertions: Current unit/public fixtures exercise direct Differences values and check resulting selected glyph IDs; the OpenType exact-xref test embeds a two-glyph program and distinguishes swapped direct names. I found no assertion where the start code or a glyph-name array member is an indirect reference.
verdict: Implementation resolves every item before classifying integer starts and names, matching §7.3.10. Existing direct-value assertions are meaningful for mapping semantics but do not cover object-reference equivalence. This is a narrow regression-test gap, not an observed implementation defect.
residuals: Parent independently verified Liberation Sans hmtx/GIDs using fontTools: quoteright455/2048,GID527; A1366/2048,GID36. Tracked PDF widths use exact222.16796875/666.9921875 rather than rounded222/667. Literal glyph IDs and advances pass for direct and indirect members. This is font-selection/interpretation, not a pixel certificate or all font-family coverage.
parent_execution: indirect_differences_spec_audit: two tests pass; model all-targets Clippy passes.

feature: Array contents versus encoded/text stream bytes
source_location: Table 112's /Differences is a PDF array of integer/name objects; §7.3.10's equivalence applies to object values. The test does not alter text-string bytes or embedded font bytes.
errata: No relevant stream-byte errata was considered in this bounded task.
test_assertions: The proposed fixture changes only whether array members are inline or indirect; the actual text string remains `<2728>` and the embedded TTF is identical.
verdict: Appropriate scope for an object-reference equivalence regression.
residuals: No claim is made about references encoded in text-stream bytes or bytes in TrueType/OpenType data tables; those are not PDF object-array members.
parent_execution: indirect_differences_spec_audit: two tests pass; model all-targets Clippy passes.
